summary: Suzi covers Day 2 of the 10-day anniversary quiz event, noting that each daily code provides 15 Heliolite Dice for a total of up to 150 summons. The video reveals the answer to the quiz question regarding Utior's true form as the violet dragon. Additionally, an official hero skill preview is shown for the upcoming Legendary Support hero, Child of Chaos, highlighting his debuff cleansing and control immunity utility.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Can switch elements, is immune to outside buffs/debuffs/energy modification, passively dispels and heals, and provides teamwide Control Immunity and Ethereal.

tips: Anniversary quiz promo codes are only active for 24 hours each, so redeem them immediately upon release.
title: MORE HELIOLITE FOR ALL! x15 🧡 QUIZ PROMO CODE #2 🎁 3rd Anniversary Event🔥 Dragonheir x Dragonstride
